summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Edeline Lee, a fashion designer. It states she was born and raised in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, and summarizes her education: a joint honors BA from McGill University in 1999, a Foundation in Arts and Design at Central Saint Martins in 2000, and a First-class BA (Honours) in Fashion Design Womenswear from Central Saint Martins in 2006.
one_line: Biographical note on fashion designer Edeline Lee, covering her Vancouver upbringing and her education at McGill and Central Saint Martins.
key_facts: Edeline Lee was born and raised in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.
Edeline Lee completed a Bachelor of Arts degree with First Class Joint Honors at McGill University in 1999.
Edeline Lee completed her Foundation in Arts and Design at Central Saint Martins College of Art and Design in 2000.
Edeline Lee graduated with a First from Central Saint Martins with a BA (Honours) in Fashion Design Womenswear in 2006.
